tools.name: make_deck_plan
tools.description: Make a sci-fi starship or space station deck plan on a square grid (1.5 m or 5 ft squares) for tabletop games like Traveller, Starfinder, Mothership, Alien, Stars Without Number or Lancer. Gives back a picture of one deck, the numbered room key, and a link that opens the same ship on the Hull & Hatc

tools.name: vtt_file
tools.description: Get a download link for one deck as a Universal VTT file (.dd2vtt) with the walls and doors already placed, for Foundry, Roll20 and Owlbear Rodeo. Says how many walls and doors it holds. VTT files are part of Hull & Hatch Pro and need a pro_code. Pass the same settings and seed as the ship.

tools.name: list_ship_types
tools.description: List what Hull & Hatch can draw: every ship type with its tonnage and crew by size, the moods and the looks, and which are free and which need Pro.

tools.name: pro_status
tools.description: With a pro_code, says if the code is good. With no code, says what Hull & Hatch Pro adds, what it costs and where to get it. Nothing is bought through this tool.
